note: Sample hotspots for the demo. The server copies these into data/db.json on first start.

hotspots.title: Shkumbin riverbank clean-up
hotspots.meet: South end of Ura e Shkumbinit
hotspots.bring: Closed shoes and water. Gloves and bags are provided.
hotspots.desc: Plastic and building rubble have piled up along the north bank near the bridge. Crews split into four stretches of about 250 m each.

hotspots.title: Graffiti removal on the Kalaja walls
hotspots.bring: Old clothes. Brushes and a stone-safe cleaner are provided.
hotspots.desc: Spray paint on the 15th-century fortress walls. A heritage officer gives a 15-minute briefing first so nothing damages the stone.

hotspots.title: Firebreak clearing above Labinot-Mal
hotspots.bring: Long sleeves, boots, lunch. Tool work is 18+; ages 15–17 run water and logistics.
hotspots.desc: The forest service needs dry brush cleared along a 1.2 km strip beside the village road before next summer's fire season.

hotspots.title: Illegal dump near the old Kombinat road
hotspots.meet: Bus stop at the Kombinat roundabout
hotspots.bring: Gloves and masks are provided. A municipal truck takes the bags.
hotspots.desc: A roadside dump keeps growing near the former metallurgical plant. Volunteers sort out recyclables and the municipality removes the rest the same day.

hotspots.title: Olive harvest for older growers
hotspots.bring: Gloves and a hat. Families provide nets and ladders.
hotspots.desc: Several older residents can no longer pick their own groves. Pairs of volunteers help one family per morning, and usually leave with a bottle of oil.

hotspots.title: Homework club at Shirgjan school
hotspots.bring: Nothing. Tell us if you're strong in maths or English.
hotspots.desc: Pupils in grades 4 to 9 need help after class. Volunteers commit to at least four weeks so the kids see familiar faces.

hotspots.title: Grocery runs for isolated seniors
hotspots.bring: A bike, or a friend with a car.
hotspots.desc: Pick up a shopping list and medicine for a neighbour who lives alone, then stay for a coffee if they want company.

hotspots.title: Playground rebuild in Papër
hotspots.meet: Papër centre, next to the school
hotspots.bring: Work gloves. Paint and timber are provided.
hotspots.desc: Two swings are broken and the fence is down. A local carpenter leads the build and shows everyone how to use the tools.

hotspots.title: Trail marking near Qafa e Krrabës
hotspots.bring: Hiking shoes, water, lunch. Paint and stencils are provided.
hotspots.desc: Mark a 7 km hiking loop with red-and-white blazes so visitors can find their way without a guide.

hotspots.title: Bus stop accessibility audit
hotspots.meet: Self-guided, start anywhere in the city
hotspots.desc: Log curbs, ramps and shelters at city bus stops with a short form. The data goes straight to the municipal transport office.

hotspots.title: Schoolyard tree planting
hotspots.bring: Gloves. Saplings and spades are provided.
hotspots.desc: Plant 60 native saplings to shade the yard where pupils wait in the heat each June.

hotspots.title: Saturday reading afternoons
hotspots.bring: A favourite children's book, if you have one.
hotspots.desc: Read aloud with children aged 6 to 10 and help them pick books to take home.

hotspots.title: Clearing the Zavalinë spring
hotspots.desc: The village drinking spring is choked with leaves and litter. Clear the channel and rebuild the stone edging.
